concerns.text: FR-001 (deterministic workflow generation) is not covered by any task. No task explicitly implements or validates the workflow generator required by the spec.
FR-002 (Full‑Context baseline engine) has no dedicated task. The orchestrator repair (T101) does not specify implementation of the full‑context execution engine.
FR-003 (Compressed‑Context engine) is not mapped to any task. The pipeline orchestrator tasks (T101, T111) do not mention implementing the BFS/DFS compression logic.
FR-004 (record token count and policy‑violation frequency per run) is only partially addressed by T112 (run‑time metrics) which records wall‑clock time, not per‑run token counts or error rates.
FR-005 (regression analysis of context reduction vs error rate) is not explicitly assigned to any task. Validation of schemas (T103) does not perform the statistical modelling required.
FR-008 (independent Oracle Policy Engine) is missing. No task builds or verifies a deterministic ground‑truth policy engine separate from the compression code.
SC-001 (error‑rate measured against ground‑truth Full‑Context log) lacks a dedicated task. No task specifies comparing compressed‑context violations to the oracle baseline.

SC-002 (token‑reduction percentage measured against Full‑Context token count) is not covered by any task. While T104 enforces tokenizer consistency, it does not record or validate the reduction metric.
Contract validation for `execution_log.schema.yaml` is absent. No task verifies that `data/processed/*_logs.json` conform to the execution‑log schema.
Creation of the per‑step binary outcome table (`step_outcomes.json`) required for the GEE regression is not assigned to any task.
Generation of `data/results/tradeoff_curve.csv` (the single source of truth for figures/tables) is not explicitly task‑mapped; T108 documents results but does not create the CSV artifact.
Generation of `data/results/analysis_results.json` (intermediate analysis artifact) is not covered by any task.
Quickstart documentation (`quickstart.md`) referenced in the plan is not created by any task.
The `StepOutcome` data‑model entity described in `data-model.md` is not produced by any task; no task expands execution logs into step‑level outcomes.
The `RunMetrics` entity is partially covered by T112, but the required fields `estimated_power` (from power analysis) and `invalid_workflow_ratio` are not guaranteed to be populated by any task.

The `paper_handoff.md` (hand‑off note) is created (T110) but does not list the `data/results/analysis_results.json` artifact, which is required by the Constitution IV single‑source‑of‑truth principle.

The adaptive‑sampling extension (T105) is marked optional, yet the plan’s success criteria (SC‑004) rely on a statistically robust threshold; without a required adaptive‑sampling task the analysis may lack sufficient data density near the inflection point.

The power‑analysis simulation (T113) is present, but the specification (SC‑004) requires a high‑confidence interval via bootstrapping for the threshold; no task explicitly performs bootstrap CI estimation for the safe‑zone boundary.
